I can't confirm this from memory. I don't know OrderLoop's refund window, and you asked me not to open files, so I haven't checked the repo for the rule.

I'm assuming a common 30-day window counted from delivery. Under that rule, a request made exactly 30 days after delivery is on the last allowed day, so it isn't late. If OrderLoop's window is shorter, such as 14 days, or if it's exclusive of day 30, the answer changes. I can search the code for the actual rule if you want.

ANSWER: no
